dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: They say that a person's residence is an accurate reflection of their character, and I find it to be quite sensible.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Now that I've seen your Realm Within for myself... Yes, you indeed possess a most intriguing character.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: My way of living differs slightly from those of others, but please don't worry about it.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I've brought everything that's important to me. After all, it's a doctor's responsibility to take care of themselves first and foremost.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of items?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Ah, just a few things for my personal use. I'm not in the best physical condition, and have to take my medicine as soon as something begins to flare up. That's why I carry a medicine box wherever I go.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Apart from the medicine, there are also quite a few bottles and jars in my possession. They're heavy and take up a lot of space, so I didn't bring too many of them along.

choices.text: Feel free to bring anything you want.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Thank you, but there really is... a lot.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: You're the owner of this place, and I don't want to take excessive advantage of your hospitality.

response.speaker: Changsheng
response.text: Ugh, look at him, mincing his words and trying to be polite. Let me explain.

response.speaker: Changsheng
response.text: If you ask me, "a lot" is a grave understatement. You wouldn't believe how many of those jars there are.

response.speaker: Changsheng
response.text: It'd probably take more than one empty room for everything to fit. Think twice before you say yes!

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Hmm... Let me write up a list then. I'll ask Gui to bring them over.

response.speaker: Changsheng
response.text: You seriously think he'll be able to carry everything on his own? Even if he got Qiqi to help, it'd still be impossible to bring them all in one go.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Perhaps I should take a trip back to the pharmacy to pack everything up, and have them delivered a few boxes at a time...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just how much stuff do you have?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Sorry. I'm a bit of a hassle to deal with...

choices.text: I have more than enough space to spare.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: What topics might you be interested in? I don't want to bore you with abstruse pharmacology, and you probably don't need to listen to my suggestions on healthy living.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Weren't you rambling about your bottles and jars? I think they're good conversation material.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bottles and jars?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: That's right. Apart from herbal decoctions, I sometimes also prescribe topical medications for my patients.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Topical medication often comes in the form of ointments and tinctures. The ingredients are complex and require a precise mixing ratio, so making them is a rather complicated process.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Of course, I wouldn't expect my patients to be experts in medicine, so I usually make everything myself.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The pre-processed ingredients essential for making the medicine are all soaked inside the jars.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Yesss. There is lots of excellent stuff in there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Such as?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Mostly just herbs. Some contain potent toxins that must be processed before they can be used.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: While we're on the subject, I have to remind you that to some degree, all medicines have detrimental side effects on the body.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The issue is not limited to a few specific ingredients — even the mildest medicines have the potential to do more harm than good if they're not used with caution.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: You should refrain from taking medicine unless it's absolutely necessary. Mild discomfort often resolves itself with time.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: So if you ever feel unwell, you should check in with me before taking anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Understood, Dr. Baizhu.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It always pays to be cautious. I had to tell you this even at the risk of sounding insufferable.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Anything I want to do? The human lifespan is limited to no more than a century, and we often find ourselves with endless desires and insufficient time.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: But we don't have to start being all deep and existential in a casual conversation... There's actually something I'm planning to do.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor is a large place. Sometimes, people get severely injured and become incapacitated, while others may land themselves in situations where it's difficult for them to ask for help.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: In either case, it is often well past the golden hour for treatment when the doctor finally arrives at the scene.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: People often wish for doctors to become more efficient, but I'm not able to teleport between places, and as a result, the best window for treatment is often missed.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: In situations like this, the patient should first try to help themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: There are many ways to render self aid before help arrives, but not everyone is aware of them.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: As a doctor, that's something within my power to change — I'm thinking of coming up with some ways to teach people basic first aid.

choices.text: I think that's a great cause.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Being a doctor comes with great responsibility, so I'm just trying to do my duty.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Having someone listen to me while I think aloud at length is already a great help.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I'll make sure to go over the details with you once I've put together a better plan.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I might need your help again when the time comes.

choices.text: Can I help in any way?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I've drafted a preliminary plan, but I still need to go over a few details to make the whole process more efficient.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Baizhu.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The fresh and crisp morning air works wonders for lifting one's spirits. There's no better time to get a head start on any important tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Hah, you both look wide awake and ready to seize the day... *yawn* You go on. I'm gonna snooze a while longer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Baizhu.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It's important to follow the body's natural rhythm and rest when the sun is down. Staying up at night and napping throughout the day may sound tempting, but it's detrimental to your health.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Ahem, my apologies, I wasn't trying to call you out or anything. I'm just too accustomed to reminding my patients of the importance of sleeping at the right time — I hope you don't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I can tell you've put a great deal of thought into decorating the study.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The potted plant in particular — it's refined and elegant in appearance, but still carries with it a subtle hint of the wilderness. For those who spend extended periods of time at their desk, it's no doubt a relaxing sight.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Taking care of the mind is an important part of healthy living. In that sense, the layout of your study is an ideal one.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: This kitchen looks like a convenient place for not only cooking, but also making decoctions. Thank you for inviting me here.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Hmm... This small stove will do nicely, and I already have all the other equipment with me.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It's a great relief knowing I won't have to keep my patients waiting. Thank you.
